Updated `src/solution.py` to remove the Friday cutoff and unsupported lunch, buffer, 15-minute increment, and duration-multiple restrictions.

It now returns every feasible minute-level start time within 09:00–17:00, in chronological order, while preventing overlaps and preserving public function signatures.

Validation passed, including 300 randomized comparisons.
